0022600089.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when Memphis hosts Utah. The Grizzlies are without Isaiah Stewart (ankle), and the Jazz are missing Jusuf Nurkic (foot), while Kyle Filipowski (back) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The teams split their four 2025-26 meetings 2-2, and the most recent one came on April 10, 2026, in Salt Lake City, where Memphis lost 147-101. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Grizzlies a 45% chance to win.
